description: Parkings public Blagnac is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Blagnac. Localisation des différents parkings public de Blagnac. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are parking, Transports, transport, Blagnac, voiture, stationnement. The portal shows 59 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
